meta.name: hotfix
meta.description: Expedited workflow for urgent production issues

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速修复线上紧急问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速处理生产环境突发问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to rapidly address production emergencies

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会指导你快速修复生产事故：从 main 分支创建 hotfix 分支，实施最小修复，验证后创建带 HOTFIX 标签的 PR，并紧急通知团队。合并后自动将 main 合并回 develop。
howto.when: 当生产环境宕机或降级、出现影响用户的严重 bug、或发现安全漏洞时触发。

say.text: 生产环境挂了，帮我跑 hotfix 流程。
发现一个安全漏洞，立即创建 hotfix 分支。
帮我通知团队有紧急 PR 需要审核。
say.note: 发送紧急 Slack 消息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will guide you through a fast-track fix for production incidents: create a hotfix branch from main, implement the minimal fix, verify, create a PR with HOTFIX label, and alert the team urgently. After merge, it merges main back to develop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when production is down or degraded, a critical bug affects users, or a security vulnerability is discovered.

say_en.text: Production is down, run the hotfix workflow.
Found a security vulnerability, create a hotfix branch now.
Notify the team about an urgent PR for review.
